name: MIDI sequencer
author: pcppcp
description: A sequencer for notes and MIDI CCs on four tracks that play along with the tape. Start recording with the first note or a count-in, then quantize the timing if needed. Each track takes notes from the keyboard, from the OP-1's sequencers or from a USB MIDI channel, and plays them to the synth, into a sequencer or out over USB MIDI.
credits: From op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
